_comment_top: Annotated example archetype. Copy this entry into cli/src/archetypes/library.json and tune for the pattern you're capturing. Strip the underscore-prefixed comment fields before saving — they're documentation only.
_comment_id: Stable kebab-case identifier. Used to derive CSS prefixes. NEVER rename without versioning.
_comment_version: Bump when match rules or content schema change in a way that invalidates prior runs.
_comment_display_name: Used as the Webflow Component name when this archetype gets promoted.
_comment_category: Loose grouping. Suggested values: hero, nav, header, features, social-proof, cta, testimonial, footer, faq, content, form.
description: Horizontal row with a small icon, a short heading, and a 1-2 sentence body. Common in mid-page benefit/feature lists.

match_rules._comment_match_rules: Three layers — gates (binary), dom (soft), content (soft). Gates filter; dom/content score.

gates._comment_gates: Hard requirements. ANY failure → confidence 0. Use sparingly; over-strict gates filter real matches.

dom._comment_dom: Soft DOM scoring. Each rule that passes adds points (weighted by confidence_weights.dom).

content._comment_content: Soft content scoring against the section's content bag.

confidence_weights._comment_weights: How DOM vs content scoring blend. {dom: 0.5, content: 0.5} is the safe default. Use higher dom for layout-distinctive patterns; higher content for text-driven patterns.

vision_prompt_hint: Horizontal feature row: small icon (24-64px) on the left, a short heading and 1-2 sentences of body text on the right. Often appears in groups of 3-6 stacked vertically.
_comment_vision_prompt_hint: ONE sentence given to Claude during the vision-fallback phase. Helps disambiguate this archetype from siblings (e.g., feature-row-image, feature-row-stat).

content_schema._comment_content_schema: Slot definitions for the rebuilder. Each slot becomes a Webflow Component prop OR an inserted slot.

icon.example: Small 32-48px icon at the start of the row.

body.example: 1-2 sentences of supporting copy explaining the benefit.
